system.biography: Object trap. The source supplies no defenses, initiative, abilities, size, movement, saves, or action points. Sheet placeholders: Medium, abilities 10, defenses 10, initiative 0, speed 0, save bonus 0, action points 0; unlisted skills use half level. HP 1 represents the minion classification; confirm object durability with the GM. Detection DCs are checks made by creatures, not this actor’s Perception skill. Triggers and conditional effects require GM adjudication.

description.value: Perception DC 20: One of the burlap sacks on the floor has something metallic peeking through.

Disable: Thievery DC 20 to disable the trap.
Step Over: A character aware of the trap can step over it with a Dexterity check (DC 4).

hit.detail: 1d6+2 damage, and the target is grabbed by its foot, if it has one (escape DC 18). Until the grab ends, the target takes ongoing 5 damage. Each time the target makes an escape attempt against the grab, the target takes 5 damage. If the trap drops the target below 1 hit point, the target loses the foot.

description.chat: You step on what looks like a discarded burlap sack, but there’s a click, and your leg feels like it’s been bitten by a dragon.
